@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M5F3FCP6BTAZ5Q8FB6PEYQXN
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 8b80
+title: 'ROUTER-4: Resolve a SessionAddress (session id, agent with optional folder, folder, tag) to targets'
+---
+## Goal
+A pure, fully unit-tested resolver that turns the `to` of an `OutgoingSessionMessage` into a decision: which sessions get the message, whether a session must be started, or why the send is refused.
+
+## Spec
+- /Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/TestudoApp/features/packages/foundationmodels-router.md#router-4-messages-between-sessions
+- /Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/session.md section 5.6
+- /Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsMultitool/session.md section 9 (the addressing table) and 13.3
+
+## What
+- New `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Directory/SessionAddressResolution.swift`: an internal function over the sender, the address, the live `SessionSummary` list, and a lookup for a recorded summary by id. It returns an internal enum, for example:
+  - `.deliver([ULID])` (live targets),
+  - `.restoreThenDeliver(ULID)` (a session id that is recorded and not live; ROUTER-5 does the restore),
+  - `.startAgent(agentID: String, folder: URL?)` (no live root session of that agent),
+  - `.refused(reason: String)`.
+- Rules (section 9):
+  - `.session(id)`: live gives that session; recorded and not live gives restore-then-deliver; archived gives refused with the reason "archived"; unknown gives refused with "unknown session".
+  - `.agent(id, folder)`: the newest live root session of that agent in `folder`, else in the folder of the sender (a `.session` sender's working folder; a `.user` sender with no folder uses no folder filter is a question, see below); none gives `startAgent`.
+  - `.folder(url)`: the newest live root session with that working folder, of any agent (no subagent, no fork); none gives refused with the hint "Name an agent: @agent:/path." (D61).
+  - `.tag(tag)`: each live session with the tag except the sender; none gives one refused. The directory never starts a session for a tag. The cap of 8 tag targets is ROUTER-5.
+  - Folders compare after `resolvingSymlinksInPath()` and with no trailing `/` (share the helper of the query card).
+
+## Subtasks
+- [ ] Failing test first: a table test with one case for each row of section 9 (session id live, recorded, archived, unknown; agent with folder, agent without folder, agent with no live session; folder hit and miss; tag hit, tag miss, tag skips sender).
+- [ ] Implement the resolver as a pure function over summaries.
+- [ ] The newest-first rule when two live root sessions match an agent or a folder; subagents and forks never match a folder or an agent address.
+- [ ] Folder canonicalization: a symbolic link and a trailing `/` match the same session.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Each row of the addressing table of section 9 has a passing test with the expected decision and reason text.
+- [ ] A folder address with no live root session is refused with the hint "Name an agent: @agent:/path.".
+- [ ] A tag address never includes the sender.
+- [ ] The resolver touches no session and no file (pure; tests build summaries by hand).
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/SessionAddressResolutionTests.swift`
+- [ ] `swift test --filter SessionAddressResolution` passes; the full `swift test` stays green.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #session #mail
\ No newline at end of file
